blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.
blocks.zh: 少有镜头的医学异常检测(MAD)基本遵循了数据集特有的"一取一取"模式,留下了统一的"一取一取多取"的模型探索不足. 将现有方法自然地扩展到这种环境,导致性能大幅退化,特别是在像素水平上. 我们将此归因于它们的探测机制:在各种损害定义中,共同决定界限变得不可靠,而只有正常的记忆库无法充分覆盖不同的正常分布,很少提及。 我们提出ProX-MAD,这是一个以代理为基础的框架,将空间环境综合为紧凑的,可学习的,针对特定国家的代词,用于统一的几发MAD. 其Masked Proxy Infusion Content(MPIA)模块交叉出入口代理代用符以用于参考补丁特性,并采用代理式的遮盖来保留高自信的函证,缓解代理倒闭,并鼓励多种代理来总结正常和异常的引用. 在所有6个医疗数据集中,ProX-MAD显示的性能只有从一分一到一分一的训练的微弱下降. 尽管只接受过一次统一模式的培训,但即使使用更优惠的一对一协议,它也平均比以往最先进的方法要好,显示了统一多数据集MAD的实用性.

blocks.en:
Medical Anomaly Detection (MAD) facilitates early diagnosis and minimizes clinical risks by identifying and localizing pathological findings in medical imaging [ 29 ] . Due to the difficulty of acquiring large-scale annotated data, recent studies in MAD have increasingly adopted few-shot learning approaches.
Few-shot MAD methods [ 14 , 32 ] have largely followed a one-for-one setting, where a separate model is trained for each dataset or clinical domain. Although this task-specific specialization yields strong performance, training a single model once and applying it across heterogeneous modalities without additional fine-tuning—a one-for-many setting ( Fig. 1 (b))—remains largely unexplored. Such unification eliminates per-dataset retraining and model storage, but requires a single model to reconcile different anatomical structures, imaging physics, and lesion definitions. Unified one-for-many modeling has been studied in general-domain anomaly detection [ 39 , 10 , 11 , 24 , 36 ] , but these methods target natural images with substantially more training data. Extending this paradigm to heterogeneous medical domains under few-shot supervision is the gap addressed in this work.
blocks.zh:
医学异常检测(MAD)通过识别医学成像中的病理发现并将其本地化,为早期诊断和尽量减少临床风险提供便利[29]. 由于难以获得大规模附加说明的数据,最近关于MAD的研究越来越多地采用少见的学习方法。
少有镜头的MAD方法[14,32]主要遵循一对一的设定,每个数据集或临床领域都培训一个单独的模型. 虽然这种针对具体任务的专业化产生强劲的绩效,但一次培训单一模式,并在不同模式中加以应用,而没有进行更多的微调——一种一劳永逸的设定(图1(b))。 这种统一消除了每个数据集的再培训和模型存储,但需要一个单一的模型来调和不同的解剖结构,成像物理学和损伤定义. 在一般域异常探测中研究了统一的一对一模型[39,10,11,24,36],但这些方法针对的是具有大量训练数据的自然图像. 将这一范式扩展至在少数情况下进行监管的不同医疗领域,是这项工作中弥补的差距。

blocks.en: Existing few-shot MAD methods [ 14 , 32 ] are trained under a few-shot supervised setting, using only a handful of annotated normal and abnormal samples per dataset. When these methods are instead trained jointly across all datasets under the one-for-many setting, their performance drops substantially, most severely at the pixel level, compared to their dedicated, one-for-one counterparts, as shown in Fig. 1 (c). We attribute this degradation to two requirements that a one-for-many model must satisfy. First, the underlying visual representation must separate normal and abnormal semantics consistently across organs and modalities. Second, the detection mechanism itself must remain consistent under domain heterogeneity while scaling gracefully as the number of domains and reference samples grows. As we show next, existing methods satisfy neither requirement. Crucially, while a spatially discriminative representation is a prerequisite, our experiments ( Sec. 4 ) show that it alone does not close the one-for-many gap. The core difficulty lies in the detection mechanism, which is the main focus of our design.
blocks.zh: 现有的几发MAD方法[14,32]是在几发的监督下进行训练的,每个数据集只使用少数附加说明的正常和异常样本. 当这些方法在一对一的设定下对所有数据集进行联合培训时,其性能会大幅下降,在像素水平上最为严重,与图1(c)所示的专用的一对一对一的对应方法相比更为严重。 我们把这种退化归结为一种一劳永逸的模式必须满足的两个要求。 首先,基本的视觉表现必须把正常的和不正常的语义在器官和方式之间一致区分开来. 第二,探测机制本身必须在域异性下保持一致,同时随着域数和参考样本的增加而优雅地扩大。 正如我们接下来所显示的,现有方法既满足不了任何要求。 关键的是,虽然空间差别化的表示是先决条件,但我们的实验(第4节)表明,单靠它并不能弥合一劳永逸的差距。 核心难度在于检测机制,这是我们设计的主要焦点.

blocks.en: To determine whether existing representations satisfy this first requirement, we examine the patch-level features on which prior few-shot MAD methods operate. Most of these methods are built on CLIP [ 28 ] , a backbone pretrained for image-text alignment rather than dense spatial discrimination. We therefore conduct a PCA analysis across several vision foundation models (VFMs), including CLIP and three DINO variants [ 6 , 9 , 33 ] , to visualize how well their patch-level features separate normal from abnormal tissue ( Fig. 1 (d)). CLIP features turn out to be spatially diffuse, with normal and abnormal regions blending together rather than forming distinguishable clusters. DINO features separate the two more cleanly, and between the three variants, the smaller patch size of DINOv1 (ViT-B/8) yields sharper, more fine-grained boundaries than DINOv2, which is particularly important for delineating small or irregularly shaped medical lesions.
blocks.zh: 为了确定现有的表述是否满足了这一第一项要求,我们研究了先前几发MAD方法所起作用的补丁级特征。 这些方法大多建立在CLIP [28] 上,这是用于图像文本对齐而非密集空间歧视的骨干预训. 因此,我们对几个视觉基础模型(VFM)进行五氯苯甲醚分析,包括CLIP和三个DINO变体[6,9,33],以可视化它们的补丁水平特征如何将正常组织与异常组织区分开来(图1(d))。 CLIP的特征在空间上是分散的,正常和不正常的区域混合在一起,而不是形成可区分的集群. DINO的特征将两者更清洁地区分开来,在三种变体之间,DINOv1(ViT-B/8)的较小的补丁尺寸比DINOv2产生更尖锐,更细细的分界线,这对于划定小的或不规则的形状的医疗损伤特别重要.

blocks.en: The second requirement concerns the design of the detection mechanism itself, and existing methods fall into two paradigms—decision-boundary and memory-bank—each of which breaks down in a different way under domain heterogeneity. MadCLIP instantiates the decision-boundary approach, adapting CLIP’s visual and textual representations to separate normal from abnormal patterns. While a handful of samples suffices to fit such a boundary within a single dataset, jointly modeling heterogeneous datasets makes this considerably harder: lesion definitions and distributional characteristics vary across domains, hindering the formation of consistent decision regions and often yielding blurred or domain-biased boundaries.
blocks.zh: 第二项要求涉及探测机制本身的设计,现有方法属于两种范式——决定的界限和内存库——两者在域异性下都以不同的方式细分。 MadCLIP将决定边界方法即时化,使CLIP的视觉和文字表达方式与异常模式相分离. 虽然少数样本足以将这种边界划入一个单一数据集,但联合模拟各种数据集则使这项工作更加困难:不同领域对损害的定义和分布特征各不相同,妨碍形成一致的决定区域,往往产生模糊或有域偏差的边界。

blocks.en: MVFA instead relies on a memory bank of normal patch-level features, against which query features are compared at inference. This design fails differently under domain heterogeneity. Because lesion size and shape vary substantially across datasets, a bank built from only a few normal references per domain cannot adequately represent each dataset’s normal distribution, and it must grow with the number of shots and domains, increasing memory cost accordingly. Moreover, even when abnormal samples are available, such methods struggle to exploit them: a single abnormal patch typically mixes normal and pathological signal, so storing it directly yields ambiguous, unreliable features rather than clean pathological representations.
blocks.zh: MVFA转而依赖于一个普通补丁级特性的内存库,在推论中比较查询特性. 这种设计在域异性下有不同的失败. 由于不同数据集的损伤大小和形状相差很大,从每个域仅有几个正常参考文献中建立的银行无法充分代表每个数据集的正常分布,它必须随着镜头和域数的增加而增加,从而增加内存成本。 此外,即使存在异常样品,这种方法也难以加以利用:一个单一的异常补丁通常会混合正常和病理信号,因此储存它直接产生模棱两可、不可靠的特征,而不是干净的病理表现。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce ProX-MAD , a Proxy-based Medical Anomaly Detection framework. Motivated by the analysis above, ProX-MAD builds on the fine-grained spatial features of a DINO backbone and represents diverse pathological and healthy patterns through a set of compact, learnable tokens. Central to our approach is the Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module, a cross-attention mechanism designed to enrich these proxies with spatial context from reference images. Specifically, MPIA facilitates state-conditioned infusion, where proxies are selectively updated with features from their corresponding diagnostic states. To prevent representational redundancy, we apply a masking mechanism to the attention maps, encouraging each proxy to specialize in distinct semantic attributes. Finally, by comparing these specialized, infused proxies with query image features, ProX-MAD generates dense anomaly maps for precise localization.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了ProX-MAD,一个基于代理的医学异常检测框架。 在上述分析的推动下,ProX-MAD以DINO骨干精细的空间特征为基础,通过一套紧凑的、可学习的标志物,代表了不同的病理和健康模式。 我们的方法的核心是Masked代理注入注视(MPIA)模块,这是一个跨注视机制,旨在从参考图像中以空间背景丰富这些代词. 具体地说,MPIA促进有条件的输液,其中代液有选择地更新,带有其相应诊断状态的特征. 为防止代表冗余,我们对关注图采用遮掩机制,鼓励每个代词专门使用不同的语义属性. 最后,ProX-MAD通过将这些专用的,注入的代词与查询图像特征进行比较,生成密集的异常地图,用于精确本地化.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We propose ProX-MAD , a proxy-based framework that performs unified few-shot medical anomaly detection by representing normal and abnormal states with compact state-specific proxies. • We introduce Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA), which injects state-matched spatial cues from reference images into each proxy and encourages diverse, complementary representations via masked cross-attention. • We demonstrate that ProX-MAD maintains robust performance in the unified one-for-many setting, exhibiting only a marginal performance drop when scaling from dataset-specific training, while surpassing prior state-of-the-art few-shot MAD methods on average.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下: 我们提议ProX-MAD,一个以代理为基础的框架,通过代表具有紧凑具体国家代理的正常和异常国家,进行统一的几发医学异常检测。 我们引入了Masked代用品注入注意(MPIA),它将来自参考图像的状态匹配空间提示注入到每个代用品中,并通过蒙面的交叉意向来鼓励多种互补的表示。 我们表明,ProX-MAD在统一的一对一的设定中保持强效性能,在从数据集特定培训中缩放时,其性能仅略微下降,同时平均超过了之前最先进的几拍MAD方法.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Vision Language and Vision Foundation Models. Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision foundation models (VFMs) have been widely adopted across various downstream vision tasks due to their strong representation learning capabilities. Among VLMs, CLIP [ 28 ] is one of the most representative models. CLIP is trained using contrastive learning on large-scale image-text pairs, aligning visual and textual representations within a shared embedding space. Through language supervision, CLIP demonstrates strong generalization ability and achieves impressive performance on a wide range of visual recognition tasks, particularly in zero-shot settings [ 44 , 16 , 45 , 7 , 46 ] . However, CLIP is primarily trained with image-level supervision, which limits its ability to capture fine-grained spatial information [ 38 , 20 , 22 ] . In addition, since CLIP is pretrained on natural image datasets, a substantial domain gap exists between its training data and medical images, often resulting in degraded performance in medical imaging applications [ 43 , 35 , 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 远景语言与远景基础模型. 愿景语言模型(VLM)和愿景基础模型(VFM)由于具有强大的代表性学习能力,在各种下游愿景任务中被广泛采用. 在VLM中,CLIP[28]是最有代表性的模型之一. CLIP是通过对大规模图像文本对齐的对比性学习进行训练的,在共享嵌入空间内对视觉和文字表现进行对齐. 通过语言监督,CLIP展现了强大的概括性能力,并在广泛的视觉识别任务上取得了令人印象深刻的性能,尤其是在零镜头设置中[44,16,45,7,46]. 然而,CLIP主要接受图像级监督培训,这限制了其捕捉精细的空间信息的能力[38,20,22]. 此外,由于CLIP在自然图像数据集上事先受过训练,因此其培训数据与医疗图像之间存在很大的域间差距,往往导致医疗成像应用性能退化[43,35,41].

blocks.en: In contrast, self-supervised vision foundation models [ 6 , 27 , 9 , 33 , 12 ] learn visual representations directly from images without language supervision. By exploiting the intrinsic visual structure and semantic consistency of the data, these models produce rich and spatially informative feature representations. Consequently, self-supervised VFMs have demonstrated superior performance in dense prediction tasks [ 37 , 40 , 8 ] , such as segmentation and localization, where fine-grained spatial understanding is essential.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,自我监督的视觉基础模型[6,27,9,33,12]直接从图像中学习视觉表现而无需语言监督. 通过利用数据的内在视觉结构和语义一致性,这些模型产生了丰富且空间信息丰富的特征表述. 因此,自我监督的VFM在密集的预测任务[37,40,8]中表现出了优异的性能,例如分化和局部化,其中精细的空间理解是必不可少的.

blocks.en: Medical Anomaly Detection. Motivated by the difficulty of acquiring large-scale annotated data in clinical practice, medical anomaly detection has progressively shifted from training on large collections of normal images [ 31 , 30 ] toward few-shot settings that require only a handful of reference samples [ 42 ] . More recently, few-shot MAD has advanced further by incorporating a small number of annotated abnormal images alongside normal references, giving rise to few-shot supervised methods such as MVFA [ 14 ] and MadCLIP [ 32 ] . MVFA adapts a pretrained CLIP visual encoder with lightweight adapters and constructs a memory bank from the few-shot normal reference features for nearest-neighbor comparison. MadCLIP instead employs dual-branch adapters with learnable text prompts to contrast normal and abnormal representations. Unified one-for-many modeling has been actively studied in general-domain anomaly detection [ 10 , 11 , 24 , 39 , 36 ] , where a single model is trained across multiple object or texture classes. In contrast, few-shot MAD has remained confined almost entirely to the one-for-one setting, and its extension to this unified paradigm has received little attention. In this work, we introduce learnable proxies that scale gracefully across datasets and shots, capturing the diverse normal and abnormal patterns that characterize different medical modalities within a single unified model.
blocks.zh: 医学异常检测。 由于难以在临床实践中获得大规模附加说明的数据,医学异常检测已经逐渐从大型收集正常图像的培训[31,30]转向仅需要少量参考样本的几发环境[42]. 最近,少发的MAD进一步推进,在正常参考文献中加入了少量附加说明的异常图像,产生了少发的监控方法,如MVFA[14]和MadCLIP[32]. MVFA调整了预先训练的带有轻量级适配器的CLIP视觉编码器,并从几发的普通参考功能中构建一个内存库,用于近邻比较. MadCLIP则使用双分支适配器,可学习的文字提示来对比正常和异常的表示. 在一般域异常检测[10,11,24,39,36]中积极研究了统一的一对一的模型,在多个对象或纹理类课程中培训了一个单一的模型. 与此相反,几乎没有几率的MAD仍然几乎完全局限于一对一的设定,它延伸到这个统一的范式几乎没有受到什么关注. 在这部作品中,我们引入了可学习的代词,这些代词优雅地跨过数据集和镜头,捕捉了单一统一模型中不同医疗模式特征的多样的正常和异常模式.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 illustrates the overall pipeline of ProX-MAD. For each state, normal and abnormal, we prepare a set of learnable proxy tokens that represent that state. The proxy tokens of both states are passed through a shared cross-attention-based Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module, which infuses each proxy with spatial context from reference images of its corresponding state. The resulting infused proxies are then compared against the patch features of a query image to produce an anomaly map, and the maximum value of this map is taken as the image-level anomaly score. We apply this pipeline at multiple intermediate layers of the backbone; for notational brevity, we omit the explicit layer index l l throughout.

blocks.zh: 3.3 将空间背景汇总为具有代表性的代理人

blocks.en: Representative proxy tokens. In few-shot medical anomaly detection, the normal reference set is extremely small and may not reflect the full distribution of normal anatomy. As a result, directly storing all spatial tokens from these references in a memory bank can be suboptimal and overly dependent on the particular samples. To address this, ProX-MAD employs a set of N N learnable proxy tokens P s ∈ ℝ N × d P^{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} for each state s ∈ { n , a } s\in\{n,a\} (normal and abnormal), where d d is the backbone feature dimension. Each individual proxy is optimized to specialize in a distinct sub-pattern within its respective state, where the number N N dictates the granularity for capturing intra-class diversity.

blocks.en: Reference sampling. During training, for each query image we randomly sample a single normal reference x − x^{-} and a single abnormal reference x + x^{+} from the same dataset’s k k -shot pool, resampling them at every iteration. Although k k references per state are available, infusing all of them at once could cause the model to overfit to a fixed reference configuration. Instead, the stochastic single-reference pairing acts as a form of reference-level augmentation: it exposes each proxy to varied reference appearances and encourages the model to generalize robustly across heterogeneous acquisition conditions. At inference we lift this restriction and use all k k references per state.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setups
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets and Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate our method on six medical datasets from the BMAD benchmark [ 3 ] : Brain MRI [ 1 , 2 , 25 ] , Liver CT [ 5 , 21 ] , OCT17 [ 18 ] , RESC [ 13 ] , Chest X-ray [ 34 ] , and Digital Histopathology [ 4 ] . We follow the evaluation protocol established by MVFA [ 14 ] and MadCLIP [ 32 ] . Brain MRI, Liver, and RESC are used for both anomaly classification (AC) and segmentation (AS), while the others are evaluated solely for AC. We report both the area under the ROC curve (AUROC) and average precision (AP) at the image and pixel levels, denoted I-AUROC/P-AUROC and I-AP/P-AP. For datasets containing multiple lesion subtypes, we evaluate over all available lesion types rather than restricting the assessment to a single subtype.
blocks.zh: 数据集与评价计量. 我们对来自BMAD基准的6个医疗数据集进行评估:脑磁共振[1,2,25],Liver CT[5,21],OCT17[18],RESC[13],胸X射线[34],以及数字病理学 [4]. 我们遵循MVFA[14]和MadCLIP[32]确立的评价协议. Brain MRI, Liver,和RESC同时用于异常分类(AC)和分解(AS),而其他则只用于AC的评价. 我们既报告ROC曲线下的区域,也报告图像和像素水平上的平均精确度,表示I-AUROC/P-AUROC和I-AP/P-AP。 对于包含多种损伤亚型的数据集,我们评价所有可用的损伤类型,而不是将评估局限于单一的亚型.

blocks.en: Implementation details. We adopt a DINOv1 ViT-B/8 [ 6 ] as the visual encoder and resize all input images to 448 × 448 448\times 448 . We extract multi-level patch features from the 3rd, 6th, 9th, and 12th layers. For each of these layers, we assign a layer-specific MPIA module (shared across states) and proxy tokens. Proxies are configured in two ways: one-for-one ( N = 4 N=4 ) and one-for-many ( N = 24 N=24 ). In the MPIA module, we apply masking with a ratio α \alpha =0.9 to encourage robustness and diversity in proxy aggregation. We optimize the trainable parameters using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . The training objective combines Dice, Focal, and BCE losses with weights λ 1 = 1 , λ 2 = 10 \lambda_{1}=1,\lambda_{2}=10 , and λ 3 = 1 \lambda_{3}=1 , respectively. All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU (48GB).

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新技术的比较 方法

blocks.en: Comparison protocol. We conduct comprehensive comparisons on six medical datasets under two evaluation protocols. The first is the one-for-one setting, where a separate model is trained and evaluated for each dataset. The second is the one-for-many setting, where a single model is trained on the aggregated few-shot data from all datasets and is then evaluated on each dataset without any additional dataset-specific fine-tuning. For fair comparisons, all methods are retrained using their official implementations under three fixed random seeds with identical few-shot samples, and we report the average performance.
blocks.zh: 比较协议. 我们在两个评价协议下对六个医疗数据集进行全面比较。 第一个是一对一的设置,每个数据集都培训和评价一个单独的模型。 第二种是一对一的设定,即对所有数据集的集成数发数据进行单一模型的培训,然后在每个数据集上进行评价,而不进行其他数据集特有的微调。 为了进行公平的比较,所有方法都使用它们的官方执行方式,在三个固定的随机种子下进行重新训练,并且有相同的几发样本,我们报告平均性能。

blocks.en: Main result. Tab. 1 and Tab. 2 report the one-for-one and one-for-many settings, respectively. At both the image and pixel levels, ProX-MAD attains the best AVG performance at every shot budget in both settings: under the more demanding one-for-many setting it reaches 89.14 / 91.31 / 92.25 % 89.14/91.31/92.25\% I-AP and 77.03 / 78.49 / 84.82 % 77.03/78.49/84.82\% P-AP at 1 / 2 / 4 1/2/4 shots, surpassing the strongest baseline at each budget (it likewise attains the best AVG AUROC in every case). The more revealing comparison is the transition from one-for-one to one-for-many, summarized in the “ Δ \Delta ” rows. When a single model must serve all datasets, prior methods lose accuracy, and the loss is most severe at the pixel level: MadCLIP’s AVG P-AP falls by 5.37 / 4.55 / 1.90 5.37/4.55/1.90 and MVFA’s by 1.76 / 1.91 / 0.73 1.76/1.91/0.73 across the three budgets, because a shared decision boundary and a common reference bank cannot absorb the heterogeneous normal/abnormal appearances of different organs and modalities. ProX-MAD, in contrast, is nearly invariant to the setting: its AVG AP never falls by more than 0.42 % 0.42\% , and it even improves at the pixel level for the 1 1 - and 2 2 -shot budgets ( + 0.22 +0.22 and + 1.06 +1.06 P-AP). This stability arises because compact, state-specific proxies encode each dataset’s normal and abnormal references without competing for a single boundary or a growing memory bank. The resulting minimal one-for-one/one-for-many gap provides evidence that a single ProX-MAD model can effectively serve multiple modalities seen during joint training.
blocks.zh: 主要结果。 Tab. 1 和 Tab. 2 分别报告一对一和多个设置. 在图像和像素方面,ProX-MAD在两种情况下的每个一试一试预算中都取得了最佳的AVG性能:在要求更高的一劳永逸的情况下,它达到了89.14/91.31/92.25% 89.14/91.31/92.25% I-AP和77.03/78.49/84.82% 77.03/78.49/84.82.82% P-AP以1/2/4 1/2/4的性能,超过了每个预算最强的基线(在每一个情况下,它也达到了最好的AVG AUROC)。 比较更能说明问题的是,从一对一到一对一的过渡,摘要见“\\Delta”一行。 当一个单一的模型必须服务于所有数据集时,先前的方法会失去准确性,损失在像素级别上最为严重: MadCLIP的AVG P-AP下降了5.37 / 4.55 / 1.90 5.37/4.55/1.90和MVFA乘以1.76/1.91/0.73 1.76/1.91/0.73,因为共同决定界限和共同参考库无法吸收不同机关和方式的不同正常/异常外观。 相比之下,ProX-MAD几乎与设定不一致:其AVG AP从未下降超过0.42%0.42\%,在像素水平上甚至为1-1和2-shot预算(+0.22+0.22和+1.06+1.06 P-AP)有所改进. 这种稳定性之所以产生,是因为紧凑的、针对特定国家的代理编码了每个数据集的正常和异常的引用,而没有竞争单一边界或不断增长的内存库。 由此产生的最小的一对一/一对一的缺口提供了证据,证明一个单一的ProX-MAD模式能够有效地服务于联合培训期间看到的多种模式.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparison. Fig. 3 contrasts anomaly localization in the one-for-one and one-for-many settings across datasets. While existing state-of-the-art methods localize lesions reasonably under the one-for-one setting, their predictions become diffuse or fragmented and drift away from the ground truth once moved to the one-for-many setting. ProX-MAD remains stable across both settings, producing sharp responses that stay well aligned with the ground truth. Moreover, even under the one-for-one setting where these methods are strongest, ProX-MAD delineates lesions more precisely. We attribute this to the combination of a DINO backbone that provides fine-grained spatial features and our proxy-based aggregation that turns them into state-specific prototypes.
blocks.zh: 定性比较. 图3对比了数据集中一对一和一对多设置中的异常本地化. 虽然现有的最先进的方法在一对一的环境下合理确定损害,但其预测却变得分散或零散,一旦转移到一对一的环境下,就会偏离地面真相。 ProX-MAD在两种情况下都保持稳定,产生与地面真相保持高度一致的尖锐反应。 此外,即使在这些方法最强的一对一的情况下,ProX-MAD更准确地描述损害。 我们将此归因于DINO主干线的组合,该主干线提供精细的空间特征,以及我们基于代理的聚合,将它们转化为特定国家的原型.

blocks.en: Effect of Backbone. Tab. 3 shows that our gains come from the design rather than the backbone: instantiated with the same CLIP ViT-L/14-336 encoder used by prior work, ProX-MAD trained in the one-for-many setting already matches or exceeds the previous one-for-one state of the art in I-AP at every shot budget (e.g., 90.26% vs. 88.03% at 1-shot, 92.05% vs. 90.81% at 4-shot), ruling out that the improvement merely stems from a stronger self-supervised encoder. Among backbones, DINOv1 ViT-B/8 achieves the best image-level AUROC and pixel-level AP across all shot budgets, despite its smaller parameter count, because its /8 tokenization produces a denser feature grid that preserves the fine-grained boundaries needed for small, irregular lesions.

blocks.en: Hyper-parameter Ablation. Fig. 4 (a) and (b) vary the number of proxies in the one-for-one and one-for-many settings, respectively: too few proxies fail to capture the intra-state diversity, and both I-AP and P-AP rise sharply from 1 to a few proxies, while gains saturate beyond 4 proxies in the one-for-one setting and 24 in the one-for-many setting, so we adopt these values. Notably, even when matched to a proxy count comparable to the one-for-one setting ( N = 6 N=6 ), ProX-MAD in the one-for-many setting still surpasses the previous one-for-one state of the art (90.81% I-AP / 82.75% P-AP). Fig. 4 (c) shows that increasing α \alpha from 0 to 0.9 yields a modest improvement in I-AP (+0.55) and a clearer gain in P-AP (+1.37), while overly aggressive masking at α = 0.99 \alpha=0.99 degrades P-AP by discarding useful reference evidence. Fig. 4(d) further shows that masking reduces intra-state proxy similarity, consistent with mitigating proxy collapse. We therefore choose α = 0.9 \alpha{=}0.9 , which best balances accuracy and diversity.

blocks.en: Core Design Ablation. Tab. 5 isolates the effect of the proxy formulation and reference infusion, starting from a training-free Frozen DINOv1 baseline that scores queries against a memory bank of normal reference patches. It performs poorly (82.18% I-AP / 42.77% P-AP), consistent with limited normal coverage and weak normal–pathological separation in frozen features. Replacing the memory bank with learnable proxy tokens (+ Proxy w/o MPIA) lifts performance to 90.32% / 83.49%, showing that optimized proxies capture domain-specific structure without storing reference patches. Infusing normal references (+ Proxy w/ F r ​ e ​ f n F^{n}_{ref} ) raises I-AP to 91.91%, while additionally infusing abnormal references (+ Proxy w/ F r ​ e ​ f a F^{a}_{ref} ) achieves the best performance (92.25% / 84.82%). With the reference set fixed, retraining across three seeds yields standard deviations of 0.51 I-AP and 0.64 P-AP in the 4-shot setting, both smaller than the corresponding gains from MPIA over plain proxies (+1.93 I-AP / +1.33 P-AP), supporting the benefit of reference infusion for learning more discriminative, state-specific representations.

blocks.en: Inference efficiency. Tab. 5 compares inference cost under a common backbone on a single A6000 (fp16). ProX-MAD attains the lowest latency (13.26 ms) and the smallest memory footprint (2126.9 MB), outperforming both MVFA and MadCLIP. Although ProX-MAD trains more parameters (29.59 M), these are learned once, are negligible beside the frozen VFM, and do not affect the inference profile. The key advantage is scaling with shots: MVFA relies on a memory bank of reference features, so its latency and memory grow as shots increase (14.15 ms / 2522.3 MB at 1-shot to 15.01 ms / 2936.1 MB at 4-shot), and this compounds when datasets are aggregated in the one-for-many setting. ProX-MAD instead summarizes the references into N N cached proxy tokens per state. Once N N is fixed for a trained model, its query-time cost does not increase with the number of reference shots, making it practical for unified multi-dataset deployment.
blocks.zh: 推论效率. 标签5比较了单一A6000(fp16)共同骨干下的推论费用。 ProX-MAD达到最低潜伏度(13.26 ms)和最小的内存足迹(2126.9 MB),表现优于MVFA和MadCLIP. 尽管ProX-MAD的列车增加了参数(29.59 M),但这些参数曾经被学习过一次,在冷冻的VFM旁边可以忽略不计,不影响推论剖面. 关键优势是用镜头缩放: MVFA依赖于参考特性的内存库,因此它的耐久性和内存随着镜头增加(14.15 ms / 2522.3 MB在1-shot到15.01 ms / 2936.1 MB在4-shot)而增长,当数据集在一对多的设定中被聚合时这种复合物. ProX-MAD转而将引用归纳为每个状态的N N缓存代理符. 一旦N N被固定为训练有素的模型,其查询时间成本不会随着参考镜头数的增加而增加,使得统一多数据集部署成为实用.

blocks.en: Proxy analysis. Fig. 5 shows, for each proxy, the query regions where its infused embedding attains high cosine similarity, revealing what each proxy attends to and captures. For the normal state, the proxies specialize along interpretable axes: some concentrate on the background and imaging field, while others attach to specific healthy anatomical regions, so together they tile the normal image rather than collapsing onto a single mode. This diversity follows directly from the proxy-wise masking in MPIA. For the abnormal state, the proxies distribute over complementary lesion characteristics, covering lesions of differing appearance, scale, and location rather than a single canonical anomaly, which is exactly what a unified model needs when lesion definitions vary across organs and modalities. Normal and abnormal proxies also remain well separated in embedding space, so the two sets act as contrasting anchors rather than redundant references. Overall, the proxies form a compact, diverse, and state-specific codebook that transfers across datasets. Beyond this, the N N normal and N N abnormal proxies also make our predictions more interpretable: because each proxy attends to a distinct, identifiable sub-pattern, a prediction can be traced back to the specific proxy that drove it, rather than relying on a single opaque similarity score.
blocks.zh: 代理分析. 图5显示每个代理的查询区域,其中其插入的嵌入具有高余弦的相似性,揭示了每个代理处理和捕获的内容。 对于正常状态来说,代理器专门使用可解释轴:有些专注于背景和成像场,而另一些则附着在特定的健康解剖区,因此它们共同将正常的图像铺平而不是倒塌在一个单一模式上. 这种多样性直接源于MPIA中的代理式遮盖. 对于异常状态,代位分布在互补的损伤特征上,涵盖不同外观,尺度和位置的损伤,而不是单一的犬科异常,这正是一个统一的模型在损伤定义因器官和模式而异时所需要的. 正常和异常的代词在嵌入空间中也保持良好的分离,因此两套作为对比锚而不是多余的引用. 总体而言,代词构成一个紧凑的,多样的,针对具体国家的代码簿,可以跨数据集传输. 除此之外,N常态和N反常代词也使我们的预测更能解释:因为每个代词都注意一个截然不同,可识别的副派,所以一个预测可以追溯到驱动它的特定代词,而不是依赖一个单一的不透明相似分数.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented ProX-MAD , a proxy-based framework for few-shot medical anomaly
detection under a one-for-many paradigm, where a single model is deployed across
multiple medical datasets without dataset-specific retraining. ProX-MAD summarizes
limited reference information into compact and learnable proxy tokens, and injects
state-matched reference cues via Masked Proxy Infusion Attention to obtain
representative and transferable prototypes for normal and abnormal states. By
computing similarity-based anomaly maps across selected intermediate layers and
optimizing with both pixel-level segmentation losses (when available) and an
image-level classification objective, our method achieves strong performance in
anomaly classification and anomaly segmentation. Extensive experiments show that ProX-MAD consistently achieves the best average performance under both one-for-one and one-for-many settings, and remains robust under cross-dataset evaluation, supporting its practicality for unified medical deployment. Because the number of proxy tokens can be flexibly adjusted, we expect ProX-MAD to scale to a substantially larger number of datasets within a single unified model.

blocks.en: Limitation. Because ProX-MAD exploits rather than manufactures the separability of VFM features, it is less effective when normal and abnormal regions are not clearly separated in the feature space. This is most visible on RESC (analyzed in the supplementary), where ProX-MAD does not surpass the memory-bank baseline in image-level ranking, although it still attains the best pixel-level AUROC ( Tab. 2 ).

blocks.en: Future work. ProX-MAD still requires a few labeled references at test time; we plan to distill the learned proxies into text-conditioned prototypes using a DINO-style vision–language backbone [ 17 ] , enabling zero-shot deployment on new modalities without any reference image.

blocks.en: A Dataset Details
blocks.zh: 数据集细节

blocks.en: We evaluate ProX-MAD on six publicly available medical datasets provided by the BMAD benchmark [ 3 ] , spanning five anatomical regions and multiple imaging modalities (MRI, CT, OCT, X-ray, and histopathology). This collection is intentionally heterogeneous in acquisition physics, anatomical structure, and lesion definition, which makes it a stringent testbed for the unified one-for-many setting studied in this work. Tab. S.1 reports, for each dataset, its anatomical category, test-set composition, and availability of pixel-annotation. Three datasets (BrainMRI [ 1 , 2 , 25 ] , Liver [ 5 , 21 ] and RESC [ 13 ] ) provide ground-truth masks at the pixel-level and are therefore evaluated for both anomaly classification (AC) and anomaly segmentation (AS); the remaining three (His [ 4 ] , Chest [ 34 ] , and OCT17 [ 18 ] ) provide only image-level labels and are evaluated for AC alone. For all six datasets, we adopt the standard BMAD train/test split and use only its designated test set for evaluation, while the few-shot reference pool ( k k normal and k k abnormal samples, k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 } k\in\{1,2,4\} ) is drawn as described in Sec. 3 .

To complement the teaser analysis in the main paper ( Fig. 1 (d)) and to
substantiate the limitation discussed in Sec. 5 , we visualize the
patch-level features of several frozen vision foundation models via PCA.
For each image, we extract dense patch features from the final layer of each
backbone, restrict them to the foreground (the imaged anatomy), and project them
onto their first three principal components, which are mapped to the RGB channels.
Under this mapping, patches that share a color occupy a similar region of feature
space, so a backbone that separates tissue types well produces spatially coherent,
well-delineated color regions, whereas a backbone whose features are entangled
produces noisy or diffuse coloring.

Second, central to our claimed limitation, the RESC (retinal OCT) rows differ markedly from the brain and liver rows. On brain MRI and liver CT, the lesion
region emerges as a distinct color cluster that stands apart from the surrounding
healthy tissue, i.e., normal and abnormal patches are separable in feature space.

along the layered retinal structure rather than around the edema itself: feature

exploits, rather than manufactures, the separability already present in the
backbone features, this weak intrinsic separation on RESC explains why our method
does not surpass the memory-bank baseline in image-level ranking on this dataset,
even though it still attains the best pixel-level AUROC ( Tab. 2 ).

blocks.zh: D 额外定性结果

blocks.en:
We provide extended qualitative comparisons of ProX-MAD across the three datasets
with pixel-level annotations (BrainMRI, Liver, and RESC) under the 1 1 -, 2 2 -, and 4 4 -shot settings. In every figure, each column corresponds to one test sample and
the four rows show, from top to bottom, the input image, the ground-truth lesion
mask (GT), the anomaly map produced by our dataset-specific one-for-one model, and the anomaly map produced by our single unified one-for-many model. Warmer colors denote higher predicted anomaly scores. These figures isolate
the effect of moving from dataset-specific to unified training: because both rows
share the same ProX-MAD design and identical references (differing only in the number of proxies), the similarity between the
one-for-one and one-for-many maps directly reflects how little our method degrades
when a single model must serve all datasets at once. Across datasets and shot
budgets, the one-for-many maps remain closely aligned with both the one-for-one
maps and the ground truth, localizing lesions of varying size, shape, and count
with substantially less diffusion or fragmentation than typically induced by unified training.
